title: A Polynomial Separation for Adaptive Fourier-Overlap Parity Decision Trees
summary: Consider the parity decision tree rule that, at every nonconstant restriction, queries a nonzero character maximizing the intersection of the current Fourier support with its translate. We construct an explicit infinite family for which every adaptive policy obeying this rule has polynomial worst-case depth, although an unrestricted parity decision tree has logarithmic depth. For every $\ell\geq1$, let $R=2^\ell$. Our function has $n=4\ell-1+R^2\ell+R$ input bits and exactly $k=R^6-R^5+R$ nonzero Fourier coefficients.
